title: Processed ship-based Multibeam Sonar Data (version 2) acquired along the Central America Subduction Zone and the Peru-Chile Trench Subduction Zone during the Melville expedition PANR02MV (1997)
description: This data set was acquired with a ship-based SeaBeam 2000 Multibeam Sonar system during Melville expedition PANR02MV conducted in 1997 (Chief Scientist: Dr. Nancy Kanjorski). These data files are of MBSystem format and include Swath Bathymetry data and were processed by the GMRT Team using the open source MB-System multibeam sonar processing software as part of the GMRT Synthesis effort. These data are included in the GMRT Synthesis, version 2.0.
